quests.title: Animal Research: Capybaras

dialogue.sit: (There seems to be something nearby worth examining. <color=#FFCC33FF>Linnea</color>, with her deep knowledge of the local ecology, might find something useful...)

dialogue.t: I warned you more than once — keep your eyes open. This is premium stock, personally requested by repeat clients in Snezhnograd.
And you just let it go? Have you gone soft on me? Did you suddenly grow a conscience or what?
Boss, listen, it's really not my fault. Those Hilichurls—
Hilichurls? You're using that as an excuse? Keep this up and you'll make a joke of our Treasure Hoarder brand!
I couldn't handle them, boss. I really couldn't! The blue one and its green friend hit harder than those Agents...
(These two... they're definitely smugglers.)
...Who's there?
Easy, Lumi! Not yet.
What's this? Hmm... A rare find.
Hey, you can handle a little girl, yeah? This looks solid enough. Let's swap it in and call it a day.
Yes, boss.
You have the nerve to go after Lumi now? You're the reason the Treasure Hoarders' reputation is in the gutter...
"Reputation"? The Treasure Hoarders have a... what now?
Stop wasting your breath on her!
They fled in a panic... Tsk, pathetic.
(The smuggled Capybara isn't here... Could this have something to do with the Hilichurls?)
(Let's see if we can find any clues nearby.)
It really is a silver Capybara... No dye, no trick of the light. This is so incredibly rare... absolutely astonishing!
I searched all over Natlan and never managed to find one. Turns out, it got snatched by smugglers.

But it doesn't seem hurt... Hehe, a silver Capybara! Never imagined I'd get to see one with my own eyes! Let me just— oh, let me feel it for a moment, see if this silver one feels any different from the ordinary ones...
Ouch! It's burning hot!
Ah, I almost forgot! You're still in the pot!
Could it be that you've grown used to Natlan's liquid Phlogiston, so this temperature barely fazes you?
Anyway, you're coming back with me for now!

quests.description: According to intel from The Flagship, a group of smugglers has been poaching rare-colored Capybaras in Natlan…
